description: This file contains benchmark tests for the Android InputDispatcher component, including functions to generate motion events, and benchmarks for notifying motion, injecting motion events, and window info changes.

classes.name: FakeInputDispatcherPolicy
classes.description: A mock implementation of InputDispatcherPolicyInterface for testing purposes.

classes.name: FakeApplicationHandle
classes.description: A fake application handle used in tests to simulate app info.

classes.name: FakeInputReceiver
classes.description: A class that consumes input events, used in tests.

classes.name: FakeWindowHandle
classes.description: A fake window handle representing a window in tests, with methods to update its info.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current system time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: generateMotionEvent
methods.description: Creates and initializes a MotionEvent with specific properties for testing.

methods.name: generateMotionArgs
methods.description: Creates and initializes NotifyMotionArgs for testing motion event notifications.

methods.name: benchmarkNotifyMotion
methods.description: Benchmark for notifying motion events through the dispatcher.

methods.name: benchmarkInjectMotion
methods.description: Benchmark for injecting motion input events into the dispatcher.

methods.name: benchmarkOnWindowInfosChanged
methods.description: Benchmark for updating window info changes in the dispatcher.
